"'''Moonface'''" was a nickname given to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. "Moonface" was a member of the criminal syndicate known as the [[Invisible Shell]]. When Organa Solo visited the [[Pearl Island Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pavo Prime/Legends|Pavo Prime]] to negotiate with the Invisible Shell for the release of [[boasa]] statues they held, "Moonface" participated in the bargaining session. He was a stocky member of his [[Species/Legends|species]] with a face shaped like a [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
